lore.text: Abused and bullied as a child, Jonathan Crane became obsessed with mastering fear instead of letting it master him. He became a psychologist at Arkham Asylum, studying its inmates. He also took a position as a university professor and was soon recognized as the world's foremost expert on fear. Ultimately, he developed a hallucinogenic "fear toxin" with which to terrorize the society that had tormented him as a boy. He created the identity of the Scarecrow as a frightening alter ego. Unlike other Gotham criminals, Scarecrow had little interest in money, instead delighting in the terror his victims felt. However, Batman put an end to Crane's reign of terror, and he ended up incarcerated in the same Arkham Asylum where he once practiced.

Scarecrow returned to plague Gotham and Batman numerous times, refining his fear toxin into various delivery systems, including gas, injectable serum, and a gel absorbed through the skin. His greatest weapon is his encyclopedic knowledge of fear and the human psyche. He has been known to drive people insane just by speaking to them for a short time. He can refine his fear toxin to create specific effects in victims or bring out their own deep-seated terrors. With every passing day, Scarecrow becomes scarier.

Scarecrow has also assumed more powerful physical forms. At one time, he mutated into a huge, monstrous man-monster called the Scarebeast. In that form, he had massively enhanced strength and endurance, and his body gave off a fear toxin in the form of pheromones. On another occasion, Scarecrow was recruited into the Sinestro Corps. Founded by Green Lantern's arch-enemy Sinestro, the yellow ring-bearing Corps members seek to cause great fear in others using energy constructs created by their power rings. Scarecrow has also worked with the Legion of Doom and the Secret Society of Super-Villains. But ultimately, his obsession with fear keeps him removed from his allies.

While exposure to his own fear gas has made Jonathan Crane immune to fear in most cases, there is one exception: Batman. This is a problem for Scarecrow, because he has become addicted to fear. As a result, he compulsively seeks out Batman, his one reliable source of fear, provoking conflicts that Scarecrow usually loses. However, until he can develop a fear toxin that works on him, Crane must rely on Batman for the fear he craves, to the misery of the people of Gotham. Scarecrow has occasionally faced other opponents, including Green Lantern and the Teen Titans, but he always returns to Gotham and Batman in the end.

At one point, Scarecrow declared himself the ultimate avatar of terror, claiming the mantle of god of fear. He used hologram projectors to cast a massive image of himself above Gotham, demanding the worship and obedience of the city's people, using his fear toxin to break their will. His plan was thwarted on that occasion, but it can be assumed that Doctor Crane still harbors aspirations of being worshipped as the god of fear. Whether he seeks that end through mind games, trickery, or some means of acquiring literal cosmic power, if he succeeds, the world will indeed have cause to tremble.

Other versions of Scarecrow throughout the Multiverse include a German agent who dies at the hands of Mr. Terrific, and Adalyn Stern, a future Scarecrow who carries on Jonathan Crane's legacy by making the people of Gotham fearful of Terry McGinnis, the current Batman. It's as if the role of an avatar of fear is one that the universe requires to exist... regardless of efforts to stop it by man or bat.

guide.overview: Scarecrow weakens enemies with **stacks of [Fear]**, reducing their physical damage while **permanently boosting his own Attack and Physical Defense**. A **Guardian** Champion who just gets stronger as the battle goes on.

legacyPieces.name: Fear Reaper
legacyPieces.reason: Scarecrow's signature gear. After casting a skill or the Ultimate, Attack and Physical Defense are permanently increased, stacking up to a cap. Also increases Physical Resistance. The Ultimate has a fixed chance to inflict [Mental Breakdown], incapacitating the target for a set duration.

legacyPieces.name: Gabriel Horn
legacyPieces.reason: Increases all allies' Attack at the start of battle. Scarecrow grants a bonus to allies at the start of battle, and with the Gabriel Horn, he can quickly secure an advantage for the squad.

legacyPieces.name: Improved Fear Gas Vial
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP and Dodge. Scarecrow needs to stay in the front row to keep building [Scare] stacks, and strong survivability ensures he lasts long enough for the stacks to reach their maximum and trigger control.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP and Attack. Scarecrow gains damage reduction upon casting his Ultimate, and the Attack bonus makes his spiritual damage skills more threatening.
